name: uav-shot-down
title: A UAV shot down
shows: The UAV is hit at +67 s of a 330 s window. `actionDestroyed` reads true while the actor lingers, so the map strikes it through and the entry's `destroyedDuringActive` says the same — and `createdGameTime` does not move, so the ready-in is the unchanged arithmetic. Who shot it down is not shown, because nothing in the recording says.
